review_scope: Direct manual reading of every one of297 HDB street→raw ACRA expanded-street pairs in street-pair-review.csv, then independent mechanical verification of every retained cited source context against pinned full CSV bytes. No manual ground-truth review of all5164 addresses is claimed.
special_cases: ST. GEORGE'S RD→ST. GEORGE'S ROAD changes only terminal RD; leading ST. and apostrophe remain.
QUEEN'S RD→QUEEN'S ROAD preserves the apostrophe and does not become QUEEN ST or another road.
EUNOS RD 5→EUNOS ROAD 5 supplies the sole observed pre-numeric RD context.
Terminal ST examples such as ANCHORVALE ST, BAIN ST, QUEEN ST and SMITH ST are explicitly spelled STREET in the raw ACRA source.
All21 CRES cases are terminal. CRES before a number is intentionally unsupported.

Semantic passes include roads whose every address remains conflicting or malformed (for example CHANDER RD, CHANGI VILLAGE RD, FRENCH RD, DOVER RD and OWEN RD); no contradiction is removed by this review.
independent_review: Independent outcome review covers complete conflicts, malformed evidence, previous-match changes, negative controls and the deterministic outcome sample.
